entities.name: Svend Åge Madsen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Svend Åge Madsen is a Danish novelist and dramatist. He studied mathematics before he began writing fiction. His novels are generally philosophical and humorous. Several of his works have been made into films in Denmark. His writings are extensive and has been translated into many languages.
